description: Early validation on calendar booking (Task 3). Disable already-booked dates/slots on the calendar UI in BookCalendar.tsx so users cannot select them or proceed to the form page.
steps: In healthcamp-client/src/pages/Events/BookCalendar.tsx, analyze how the event calendar data is structured. The data comes from /assign-calendar/for-service/:enrollId?serviceId=X and returns an array with eventCalendar entries that have isBookable boolean and date fields.

Modify the selectSlot function in BookCalendar.tsx to check: (a) if the date's isBookable is false, show a toast and return early (this already partially exists), (b) Also check the booking status - cross-reference with existing bookings data. If a slot for that date is already booked (status booked), prevent selection.

Update the dayPropGetter function to visually mark already-booked dates as disabled (red background already exists for non-bookable). Ensure that dates where isBookable is false have pointer-events: none and cursor: not-allowed, making them truly unclickable.

In the slot selection modal, add validation: when a user selects a slot, check if that specific slot is already booked. If the slot count matches booked count for that date, disable the select button for that slot.

Ensure the 'Book Event' button at the bottom only enables when all selected slots are actually available (not just matching count). The current check (numberOfSlots !== data?.[0]?.requestedSlot) remains, but add an additional guard that prevents navigation if any selected date has isBookable=false.
acceptance_criteria: Dates marked as non-bookable (isBookable=false) in the calendar data are visually disabled with red background and cannot be clicked
Attempting to select a non-bookable date shows a toast error and does not open the slot modal
Dates outside the start-end range remain disabled with gray background and pointer-events: none
The Book Event button is disabled if any selected slot corresponds to a non-bookable date
Users cannot proceed to the /calender-form page with invalid slot selections
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit in healthcamp-client directory to verify no TypeScript errors
findings: All four changes implemented successfully. TypeScript compilation passes cleanly. The isBookable check was moved before slot generation in selectSlot. Non-bookable dates now have pointer-events:none. Book Event button validates slots before navigation. Modal disables select buttons when slots are consumed. Post-review fix: added null guard (data?.[0]?.eventCalendar?.some(...) ?? false) to dayPropGetter to prevent crash if API returns empty array.
